title: Pons V2 launch-origin historical denominator extractor
objective: Implement the minimum deterministic code needed to extract launch-origin fields for an outcome-blind exact Pons V2 factory sample under PONS_V2_LAUNCH_ORIGIN_MATCHED_DENOMINATOR_v1. Do not interpret outcomes, fit thresholds, score tokens, activate alerts, or change market/trading semantics.
required_behavior: Sample exact Pons V2 TokenLaunched factory rows from a caller-supplied contiguous block range before any outcome lookup.
Preserve every sampled launch row, including dead/no-market launches and rows with enrichment failures.
Decode/freeze exact token CA, launch tx, block/log identity, deployer, pair token, launch config id and graduation threshold from the canonical factory event.
Fetch the launch transaction/receipt deterministically and expose method/input decode health. If launchAndBuy origin fields cannot be decoded, persist UNKNOWN rather than dropping the row.

Where reproducible from exact launch input/receipt, record creator/caller, recipient, quote in, initial tokens out, total supply, initial creator/caller supply percentage, creator tax/config, snipe-tax exemption count and exemption-address hash.
Keep exemption membership distinct from token allocation, ownership, insider status and paid promotion.
Emit source/provider health, observed/retrieved timestamps and evidence hashes.
Deduplicate only by canonical chain log identity.
Output a deterministic historical representation artifact suitable for >=30 rows. Do not fetch outcome/price/social labels in the extractor.

positive: DEED fixture reproduces exact CA, launch tx and 2.99% initial caller position plus 25 exemption addresses/hash where fixture evidence supports it.
TAGPAD fixture reproduces ~1.5% creator position and 3 exemptions where canonical fixture evidence supports it.
FLYBRAIN row is preserved even if some origin fields remain UNKNOWN.
A sampled launch with no market data remains in the denominator.
Repeated overlapping block scans deduplicate by block_hash+tx_hash+log_index without denominator loss.
negative: Provider failure or decode failure cannot become zero exemptions or zero creator position.
Exemption address cannot be labelled insider, allocation recipient or common owner without separate evidence.
No market outcome, ATH, social scam/gem label, wallet score or later sell-through may influence sample inclusion.
No new scanner, scheduler, score, forecast engine, alert, portfolio action or trade authority.
No production threshold or weight is introduced.
